newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RIVALDO KEEPS ALIVE DEPORTIVO'S EURO BID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RIVALDO KEEPS ALIVE DEPORTIVO'S EURO BID.

text.p: Two goals from Brazilian midfielder Rivaldo enabled Deportivo Coruna to keep up their challenge for Spain's second European Cup place with a hard-fought 2-1 victory at struggling Logrones on Sunday.
The win left Deportivo two points behind second-placed Real Betis -- 1-0 winners at Tenerife on Saturday -- and level with Barcelona who were at home to Athletic Bilbao later on Sunday.
Leaders Real Madrid travel to Valencia on Monday with an eight-point lead over Betis.

A fine performance by international striker Kiko Narvaez helped troubled champions Atletico Madrid to haul themselves out of a rut with a 3-1 victory over fellow UEFA Cup hopefuls Valladolid, while Zaragoza pulled further out of the danger zone with a 3-2 win over Rayo Vallecano.
